alisha: Quick heads-up — All-Hands this Wednesday 09:00 PT. 45m total: roadmap, policy updates, incident learnings, + 15m live Q&A. Drop questions below or use anonymous form: https://forms.redwood-inference/ah-wed. Recording posted after.
marco: Draft agenda: 1) Product highlights (10m) 2) Dedicated capacity & pricing (8m) 3) Policy changes: data retention & SSO (7m) 4) Incident recap & mitigations (10m) 5) Q&A (15m). Feedback?
priya: Please add a short launch note for the new quantized model rollout (2 slides).
alisha: Agreed, keep it to rollout guardrails and timelines.
sam: I'll include the incident mini-postmortem slide with timeline and owners.
jen: People Ops quick update: hiring freeze lift announcement — 30s verbal, no slide.
leo: I'll prepare a single slide showing console UX tweaks.
ravi: Legal will provide a concise privacy blurb about retention changes for the slide deck.
priya: Question: will SSO enforcement be phased? Any impact on self-serve customers?
alisha: Phased rollout — specifics (tiers/dates) will be announced during the policy segment.
marco: Clarification for Dedicated: pricing change targets new reservations only; existing contracts unaffected.
jen: Can we have a 08:30 PT pre-brief for IC leads to flag red flags?
alisha: Yes — pre-brief 08:30 PT. Invite incoming.
priya: Will incident recap include follow-up owners and due dates?
sam: Yes — owners + due dates will be on the slide.
marco: Post any sensitive questions to the anonymous form. Tag me for product details.
priya: Posted: "Will quantization change inference SLAs for Dedicated customers?"
alisha: We'll answer in Q&A: short: no SLA change immediately; config suggestions may follow.
alisha: Reminder: submit slides by Tue EOD to the all-hands folder: https://drive.redwood-inference/allhands/wed.
leo: Got it. :thumbsup:

--- (post-meeting) ---
townhall-bot: Recording uploaded: https://videos.redwood-inference/ah-1901112222. Transcript attached.
marco: Recap/takeaways: 1) Roadmap focus: latency, model catalog growth. 2) Dedicated pricing applies only to new reservations. 3) Policy: data retention reduced from 90d -> 30d for non-enterprise effective June 1; SSO enforcement phased starting July 15. 4) Incident: root cause autoscaler bug; mitigations: patch, extra e2e tests, runbook updates. 5) Actions and owners on slides.
sam: Incident actions: Sam -> monitoring patch (done), Maya -> autoscaler test coverage (due 1901200000), Ops -> follow-up review scheduled next week.
ravi: Legal uploaded privacy blurb + created FAQ: https://docs.redwood-inference/legal/privacy-ah.
jen: People Ops follow-up: details on hiring freeze lift in notes; DM for role prioritization.
priya: Will comms publish a public blog post about the policy change?
marco: Yes — comms will draft, target publish June 5. Draft will be shared with leads.
alisha: Thanks everyone for the quick prep. If anything unanswered, add here or DM me. :sparkles:
